summary.text: James Tipton is a Republican state representative from Kentucky who has represented District 53 since 2015 and is seeking re-election to the Kentucky House of Representatives in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Tipton is a farmer and chairs the Postsecondary Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: James Tipton was born in Taylorsville, Kentucky, and graduated from Taylorsville High School in 1977.
He earned a bachelor of science in agriculture from the University of Kentucky in 1981 and a master's degree in vocational education there in 1985.

His career experience includes working as a realtor and a farmer, and he has been a member of the Spencer County Farm Bureau, the Anderson County and Spencer County chambers of commerce, the Kentucky Cattleman's Association, the Louisville Area Agricultural Club, and the Kentucky Association of Realtors.
In the 2025-2026 session he chaired the Postsecondary Education Committee and also served on the House Agriculture, State Government, and Primary and Secondary Education committees.
